title: tk client: every manifest command over tk --json, contract 1, fail closed on mismatch
description: internal/tk: a client for the 15 commands in contracts/tk-json-manifest.json (reads: version, show, list, ready, next, deps, graph, status; writes: claim = update --status in_progress, update, note, close, reopen; exit-code drivers merge-file/merge-activity). Every call passes --json-contract 1 (TK_JSON_CONTRACT) and surfaces exit 11 as a typed ErrUnsupportedContract; exit 8 (dispatch width) typed. Responses are validated against the manifest schemas with internal/schema before use. Tests run against a real tk binary in a fixture repository (tk init in a temp dir), skipped with a clear message when tk is not on PATH, plus a fake for unit tests. Minimum tk version from the manifest is checked once at startup.
acceptance_criteria: A table test exercises all 15 commands against a fixture repo and validates each response against its manifest schema; an unsupported contract fails closed with the typed error; go test -short ./internal/tk/... green.
